mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the macrophages was most worthwhile because it showed a second defense and made clear that the airway lining does not catch everything.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the lining to the body before it could catch particles felt like an assembly requirement; I had expected to explore the lining's function first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the lining had to be attached to the body before it could be combined with inhaled material.

arbitrary.text: That required order felt somewhat arbitrary from the visible descriptions, although the compatibility feedback made the next step clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the body responds to microbes that get past these defenses. The sequence was clear, though most combinations were predictable.
